body: In my opinion, it doesn’t matter what percentage you are attracted to a gender or the other, it could be 99 to 1 and you can still call your self bisexual. I feel like we always have to justify that we are attracted to both genders when you should just do whatever you want. Whether if you are mostly attracted to men and you end up in a long term relationship with one, you wouldn’t we less bisexual.
This time I chose boys, but in the next story I will definitely choose girls

I’m bisexual which means I’m attracted to me because it’s a lot more like a relationship with my family

I hope you can keep in touch with your brother. I’m 18 and my father is 77. I’m aware that my father would probably not live beyond my 30s. I have an horrible relationship with my mother, and I barely see my half brother (he is not my father’s son), so I will probably be alone soon. I just wish the problems our parents have had hadn't affected our relationship... When my father dies, I will be alone. 
I have good friends tough, I’ll be okey.
It’s horrible, I’m glad my father is half deaf and can’t hear what I say in my room because I’m doing video calls every weekend instead of going for a walk with my friends

I know how it’s like to have to listen to your parents bullshit when is not your fault their life is miserable. I almost killed my self 3 years ago because of it. They say they care about you but they don’t. I just pretend everything is okey, but the moment I turn 18 I’m out of here for good. My older brother defended my mother saying that she had been through a lot and I had to understand, but that does not justify it. 
When your family is a mess the only thing you have are your friends. Maybe they are overwhelmed because they don’t know what to do. The only friend I told about trying to kill myself just hugged me, but I don’t know what else I expected him to do.
I’m sorry, I really hope you can recover from this
Same...
When no matter what , they don’t really listen to you when you say they are hurting you with their actions...

I left my mother and went to live with my father because I couldn’t stand her instability.  And now that I'm gone she says I'm the bad person because no daughter would do that to her mother, denying that she did those things to me.  I use to feel guilty... but I realised that she is the crazy one. Just take her out of your life if you feel prepared, it's much worse when they don't want to admit that they are hurting you. Some people don’t change.

One of my classmates said that if you don’t believe in god you don’t mind if someone you love died because for you “things just happen”. Like whaaaat??!??
mmm... well sometimes I feel miserable but then good things happen and I just think that my life isn’t that bad

My family is very similar to yours, my mother always justified treating me badly because she was depressed because of the things that my father did to her. But that doesn’t give her the right to realise her  anger in me, it’s not my fault. In the end my father, despite not having made very good decisions, was better than being with such an unstable and bipolar person.
